findings.problem: Generic folding made independent branch paths look like consecutive stages.

findings.evidence: Three aligned paths; exact canonical cuts and 1 unknown preserved. Geometry does not assert execution concurrency.

findings.problem: Resource cuts created orphan parameter inputs and the same x appeared twice for data and interface use.
findings.change: Attach constant parameter cuts to consumers; share an input only for the same canonical source and output slot.
findings.evidence: All 8 branch cuts retained: 2 resource annotations, 3 uses of one x input, 3 distinct output slots. Modified parameters remain data inputs.

findings.evidence: WideBranches 13 panels; stress 2–48 paths, 1834 panels, no geometry/size/accounting failures.

findings.evidence: Eight values, eight result terminals and sixteen uses/cuts; browser widths 7/8 and boundary regression.

findings.problem: Focused panels duplicated a single result for each external use, producing redundant crossings.

findings.problem: Visual review found disconnected loop-variable terminals; the same defect occurred at external alias consumers.

findings.problem: Early greedy routes never considered later wires and left avoidable crossings.
findings.change: Revisit at most eight crossed wires over two passes, reserving all other selected routes. Accept only strictly fewer crossings with no increase in unrelated contacts or new contacting edge pairs, and with font/label/path gates preserved; restore the final route cache.
findings.evidence: Archived comparison: 261 to 137 crossings, 60 panels reduce crossings; four DenseBlock overviews separately add one crossing each to remove contacts. findings.problem: Strict crossing counts missed unrelated elbows touching; a rejected rerouting prototype looked better numerically while introducing misleading junctions.
findings.change: Record unrelated contacts separately, penalize endpoint contact during rerouting and reject new contacting pairs or contact count increases. Compare renderer versions in separate VM globals to avoid shared CommonJS registries mixing engines.
findings.evidence: Rejected prototype: 146 crossings and 112 contacts, with 24 panels adding contacts. Corrected contact count: 68 to 0; contact-diagnosis/contacts.json preserves the evidence.

findings.problem: Contact-only diagrams never entered crossing repair, and equal-crossing improvements were rejected.
findings.change: Run a separate contact phase after crossing repair; require strictly fewer contacts with no crossing, contacting-pair or quality regression.
findings.evidence: Archived cumulative contact comparison: 66 to 0 contacts across 33 improved panels; all 1346 positions and accounting records unchanged. Crossings 133 to 137 include the four later separation tradeoffs. Zero-crossing original DAG regression included.

findings.problem: Fixed 16-unit terminal stubs could meet across a 32-unit row gap.
findings.change: Contact repair also tries 12/8-unit lead-ins without moving physical terminals or changing operand identity. The two monotone stages use at most 96 attempts.
findings.evidence: Tight-gap route regression and current ConditionalVAE before/after visual review; TextCNN actual UI export retains four crossings and zero contacts. A later separation pass handles the eight remaining contacts.

findings.problem: The final eight contacts could not be removed while forbidding every crossing increase; source-sharing and coordinated-route prototypes did not give a suitable result.
findings.change: After the monotone stages, try at most four implicated edges once. Permit at most one extra crossing per diagram only when more contacts disappear than crossings are added, no new contacting pair appears, and all existing quality gates remain valid. At most 112 total attempts.
findings.evidence: All 1346 archived diagrams reproduced: contacts 8 to 0, crossings 133 to 137. Four DenseBlock overviews each trade two contacts for one explicit overpass. Actual UI SVG reconstruction and original tight-geometry regression confirm the result; this is an explicit readability tradeoff.

findings.problem: Dependency-band captions exposed only depth and unit count, so a compact overview still gave little computational meaning.
findings.change: Inventory each direct semantic unit using confirmed operators or local findings; keep unknowns explicit. findings.evidence: 69 external inventories, 35 with content captions; 50 panels have changed captions. findings.change: Compose an exact gated-sum finding with both product/gate/value/sum edges and operand slots, retaining nested gate groups and external uses. Reject mutation, conditional operands, ambiguous slots, mixed evidence and nonunit alpha.
findings.evidence: Original GatedMixture source combines EncoderLayer, RNN, two partial gates and an unresolved kernel. Four panels pass. The extra product output remains a cut to return slot 2. findings.evidence: GatedMixture overview: 13 to 11 visible nodes; row-gap retry removes all three missing labels, retaining four crossings and zero contacts at 8.25pt. Actual UI SVG/doc reconstruction and complete 12-atlas text measurements pass. All 1346 external SVGs remain byte-identical to the archived implementation; none exercised this fallback.

visual_limits: Path group names describe topology; algorithm meaning still requires detail panels and semantic evidence.
Serial detail can fill a 240mm page; overview and detail must be used together.
Recognition is bounded to 2–64 paths, 64 nodes per path, 96 interior nodes; paths must be linear after valid nested grouping. Dense or unsupported structures keep ordinary topology layout.
Stress covers separated 2–48 paths with two operations each; it has no per-panel browser text measurements and does not establish all dense or cyclic cases.
Framework TransformerEncoderLayer internals remain a contract rather than an inferred implementation.
Unknown kernels, incomplete static semantics, complete MoE roles and arbitrary-model publication quality remain unresolved.
Dependency-band/Units labels describe topology, not algorithm meaning; detailed panels retain cross-links.
TextCNN loop and ConditionalVAE detail remain dense; 8pt and no overlap are necessary but insufficient.
Weave stress covers cyclic-neighbor DAGs only; full sweep has no per-panel browser text measurements. Widths 7/8 were measured separately.
Some panels have more crossings after previously missing dependencies are restored; inspect routing-comparison.json crossing_increases. These remain visual limitations.
GatedMixture remains a tall 240mm overview with four crossings; its local gated-sum panel is clearer but does not establish whole-model publication quality.

Rerouting can lengthen wires: 57 corpus panels have longer paths, with a maximum total-length ratio 1.48. The reviewed DenseLayer detour eliminates four crossings within the same frame; longer paths remain a readability tradeoff, not global optimality.

There remain 0 unrelated contacts in the measured corpus. Four DenseBlock diagrams gain one explicit crossing each to remove their final contacts; other topologies can still contain contacts. The green font/path gates alone do not prove this diagnostic is clear.
